name: Gauge
label: Gauge
description: A radial dial for a single bounded reading, recoloured through the status roles as it crosses thresholds.

props.name: value
props.description: Current reading. Clamped into the `min`–`max` range for drawing.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Colour role for the value arc. `accent` (the default) follows the chart
palette's lead colour. Ignored while a threshold matches — thresholds
exist so the dial recolours itself as the reading crosses them.

props.name: thresholds
props.description:
Colour switch points, e.g. warning at 70 and error at 90. The highest
threshold at or below the current reading wins; below them all, the
`tone` prop applies.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the reading in the centre of the dial.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the centre reading — for units, precision, or locale.

props.name: label
props.description:
What the reading measures, shown as a caption under it and used as the
accessible name, e.g. "CPU usage".

props.name: title
props.description:
Chart title, in the shared chart header.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which Gauge does not expose.

props.name: bare
props.description: Strip the card chrome (border, padding, fill) when the chart sits inside another panel that supplies the surface

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered dial diameter in pixels. The arc geometry scales with it.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the value is written in when no `formatValue` is given, such as `ar-EG`. Defaults to `en-US`. This component can render from a Server Component, so it takes the prop alone and reads no LocaleProvider.
